jconon_application.afl_cittadinanza_italiana_lista: to be in possession of Italian citizenship
jconon_application.fl_obblighi_militari: to be in good standing with regard to military obligations, if subject
jconon_application.fl_condanne_penali_nuova_normativa: not to have received criminal convictions with a final judgment for crimes that entail disqualification from holding public office
jconon_application.fl_procedimenti_penali_nuova_normativa: not to have any pending criminal proceedings of which one is aware or administrative proceedings for the application of security or prevention measures or previous criminal records against oneself that can be registered in the criminal record
jconon_application.fl_licenziamento_disciplinare: not to have been dismissed for disciplinary reasons in accordance with the national collective bargaining agreements stipulated for the sectors of the Public Administration
jconon_application.fl_terzo_anno_dottorato: to be enrolled in the third year of the PhD and to obtain the qualification within six months following the date of publication of this announcement
jconon_application.fl_ultimo_anno_corso_specializzazione: to be enrolled in the final year of the medical specialization course and to obtain the qualification within six months following the date of publication of the announcement
jconon_application.fl_curriculum_scientifico_professionale_: to be in possession of a scientific-professional curriculum suitable for carrying out research activities
jconon_application.fl_conoscere_lingua_inglese_rilevante_ri: to know the English language and/or any other languages required by the call that are relevant to the research
jconon_application.fl_dipendente_ruolo_tempo_indeterminato: not to be a permanent employee of the institutions referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 22 of Law No. 240 of 30 December 2010, nor to have benefited from contracts referred to in Article 24 of the same Law
jconon_application.fl_titolare_posizioni_artt_22: not to have held positions referred to in Articles 22, 22bis, 22ter of such duration as to prevent, pursuant to Article 22ter, paragraph 9 of Law 240/2010 and paragraphs 2 and 3 of Article 2 of the notice, the activation of the contract which is the subject of the notice itself
jconon_application.fl_rapporto_parentela_direttore: not to have a relationship of kinship or affinity up to and including the fourth degree, of marriage or civil union between persons of the same sex, as regulated by Article 1 of Law 20 May 2016, n. 76, or not to be in a state of de facto cohabitation, as regulated by Article 1, paragraphs 37 and following of the same law, with the Director of the facility receiving the position
jconon_application.fl_tempi_aggiuntivi: Need for additional time or aids during the exam

jconon_application.fl_autorizzazione_trattamento_dati_perso: I authorize the processing of my personal data in compliance with current legislation on the protection of personal data and, in particular, the European Regulation for the protection of personal data 2016/679, Legislative Decree 30/06/2003 no. 196 and subsequent amendments and additions, as last amended by Legislative Decree 10/08/2018 no.

home.title: CNR E-Recruitment
home.subtitle: Online application system for recruitment of staff and other types of employment and training of the National Research Council of Italy.

footer.first: The platform is part of the e-government project of CNR, in coherence with the Administrative Digital Code and regulations concerning optimization of the productivity of public work and of efficiency and transparency of public administrations and their simplification and development*.*27 October 2009, legislative decree, n. 150, on "Implementation of the 4 March 2009 law, n. 15, on the matter of optimization of the productivity of public work and of efficiency and transparency of public administrations" and the recent 9 February 2012 legislative decree, n. 5, "Urgent measures of simplification and development" (art. 8  Simplification of participation in recruitment competitions and testing).
footer.second: The hosts procedures developed to allow participation in the notices issued by the organization's structures. The procedures are developed starting from the specifications produced by the structures issuing the calls and must comply with the rules imposed by them.

spid.info: SPID, the Public Digital Identity System, lets you access the online services of the Public Administration and accredited private parties with a single digital identity. If you already have a digital identity, sign in with your provider's credentials. If you don't have one yet, request it from one of the providers.
